_comment: Tracker's warm palette -> Flo Kit 2.0 neutrals. App variant only; build.py applies it to inline style= attributes when writing site/app/tracker/index.html.
_provisional: Resolved against the Flo Kit colour ramps: foreground/neutral default #161617, muted #5C606B, faint #8E95A5; surface/canvas #FAFBFC; outline/neutral default #C8D0DF, faint #DEE4ED.
_scope: Derived from every hex in the template, not just inline style= attributes -- chart gridlines, scrollbars and hover states live only in <style> blocks and JS.
_protected: Anything with chroma > 60 that carries meaning on its own (errors, warnings, status tints). Chart series are no longer protected -- they map onto the Flo Kit accent ramps.
_tint: Tinted surfaces split by role rather than by hex. True hover states (.campus-row, .share-item, .row-expand) take white/10 #F8FAFC = background/surface/hover. Static tints -- table footer bands, chart label plates, scrollbar tracks, the preview-card header band -- take neutral/10 #EDF2F8 = background/neutral/faint, so they separate from the white card instead of hovering a hair above it. Chart gridlines are an SVG stroke, not a surface: they take outline/neutral/faint #DEE4ED. Mapping them to a surface token scored 1.046 against the white card, which is invisible.
_contrast: Stat numerals take the sparkline colour (see _stats); the active tab and section headings keep primary #0174BE. Three tinted surfaces, three values: the segmented toggle track sits on primary/10 #EDF5FC, the preview-card header band on #EDF4FA -- deliberately off-ramp, the midpoint between primary/10 and neutral/10, asked for because both ramp steps read wrong at that size -- and the other static tints (footer bands, chart label plates, scrollbar tracks) on neutral/10 #EDF2F8. Uppercase table headers take neutral/80 #393B41 rather than foreground/muted #5C606B; small letterspaced caps need the weight back.
_charts: Chart series -> accent ramps, by CIELAB distance, with three departures from nearest-neighbour. (1) Both light blues go to the info ramp rather than primary, so data never wears the same blue as buttons, links and the active tab. (2) #4D8EFF darkens further than distance alone would ask, because it also sets uppercase label text that scored only 3.17 on white. (3) #192B92-as-series goes to info/90, not the nearest step, to hold its separation from #4D8EFF's info/50 -- they are two series in the same chart four times over. Final: #4D8EFF -> info/50 #3B6DA3, #9DC3FF -> info/30 #7DADD0, #4DA54C -> success/40 #2E9C56, #FC97C2 -> purple/30 #B27EBB, #192B92-as-series -> info/90 #172D45. #EB232D stays (semantic red). Worst-pair separation across the 5-series set is dE 31.7, vs 40.4 before.

context.why: Quoted = JS chart config: lineChart/barChart series colours, donut and point fills, the series-by-year maps. #192B92 pairs with #4D8EFF as two series in four charts (a light/dark blue year-over-year pairing), so it takes info/90 -- the far end of the same ramp #4D8EFF's replacement sits at. Mapping both to info/50 collapsed two distinct series onto one colour.
Donut ring in the static SVG.
Legend swatch beside a series label.
#FBFAF6 is nine static table footer bands plus this one row hover. The bands want neutral/10; the hover wants surface/hover, so pin it before the flat pass takes it.

All eight overview-card subheaders are this one markup shape; seven use #9A948C and the 1L-2L card uses #8A857C. In the warm palette the two greys were 3.67 vs 3.36 on white -- indistinguishable. The Flo Kit mapping puts them either side of the muted/faint boundary (6.29 vs 3.00), so an invisible inconsistency became a loud one. Normalise to the other seven before the flat pass; #8A857C's other 19 uses are real secondary text and keep muted.
Bar-chart track plate -- a surface, not a rule. #F1EEE8's other ten uses are borders and now take an outline token, so this one has to be pinned first.
Panel background -- a surface. #E7E3DB's other sixteen uses are rules.
The remaining three stat numerals are already #0174BE in the template (the public-interest cards), so the #192B92-keyed rules cannot reach them. Same numeral shape, same destination.

_dividers: Rules and dividers take outline tokens, never surface tokens. Three source hexes (#EFEDE7, #EFECE6, #F1EEE8 -- 49 border uses) had landed on background/surface/canvas #FAFBFC, which scores 1.036 against a white card: invisible. Two tiers preserve the tracker's own hierarchy -- lighter rules to outline/neutral/faint #DEE4ED, heavier ones to outline/neutral/default #C8D0DF, which 15 borders in the template already use directly.
_stats: Overview-card stat numerals take info/90 #172D45 -- the exact colour of the preview sparkline they sit above. Primary #0174BE is too bright for the in-app density. There are 13 numerals arriving as two source hexes (#192B92 on the law-firm cards, #0174BE on the public-interest ones), so both are pinned. Scoped by letter-spacing, which every numeral carries and the chrome (active tab, section headings, links) does not; those stay primary.
